review_reference: Owner decisions of 2026-11-17, verbatim in chat: Q90 "Q90 A since its the best option that gives each product seperate environment"; Q91 "Q91 A". Meaning: in the Q88 product gate (identity-api src/auth/product-gate.ts, PR #256), an administrator (organization.manage, or the administrator of a self-signed-up facility awaiting review) counts as a hospital role only at an organisation that is not recorded as a laboratory or a pharmacy; an organisation with no recorded kind, or with any hospital or clinic kind, is a hospital (Q91 A); laboratory only admits the administrator on lab. only, pharmacy only on pharmacy. only, laboratory and pharmacy on both. Clinical hospital roles (ehr.encounter.write) and the lab, pharmacy and outreach roles are unchanged. Production has 0001-0123 (0122 and 0123 signed as Q84 and released); its pending set after this branch is exactly 0124. Unsigned: reviewed_by stays empty until the owner signs under 0124.
evidence: Migration 0124_organization_staff_kinds.sql plus its runtime-grants.sql block. WHY: the kind is recorded only in identity.organization_applications.organization_type (clinic, hospital, laboratory, pharmacy, other), linked to the organisation by identity.organization_products.source_application_id; the Identity runtime has no privilege on either table, and identity.organization_self_service_state (0086) answers only self-signed-up organisations. WHAT IT DOES: one new function, identity.organization_staff_kinds(target_organization_id uuid) returns text[], LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER, search_path pg_catalog, identity, pg_temp, owned by the owner of identity.organization_self_service_state: the distinct effective kinds, sorted, of (a) the application behind each of the organisation's active organization_products rows and (b) the self sign-up application organization_self_service_state reads (newest approved or released self-service application with no reviewer) while it is not released; 'other' gives 'hospital' when that application's product_code is ehr or migrate (as identity.staff_invitable_roles gives it the hospital roles) and nothing otherwise; a suspended product gives nothing; the answer is only clinic, hospital, laboratory or pharmacy and is empty when nothing is recorded (the sealed QA Hospital, Demo Hospital and Demo Outreach, outreach groups and legacy-promoted organisations). EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC and granted to hid_identity_runtime only, in the migration (when the role exists) and in runtime-grants.sql. PRECONDITIONS (catalog reads only, 55000, nothing applied): 0123 applied (identity.sealed_qa_facility(uuid) exists) else '0124: 0001-0123 must be applied first'; not applied yet else '0124: already applied'; the twelve columns it reads with 0046's and 0086's types; the organization_type, product_code and product status checks exactly 0046's; the bodies it mirrors by md5 (organization_self_service_state c67aa5224b2aa3d95e4415e26787d470, staff_invitable_roles b6f4068712d97284fd95d169e3bde0cf). Post-checks: attributes, owner, and no EXECUTE for any role but hid_identity_runtime. No table, column, index, constraint, policy, trigger, role or permission change; no other function changes; no row read or written by the file; CREATE FUNCTION and GRANT take no table lock. runtime-grants.sql gains one block (grant EXECUTE to hid_identity_runtime; revoke from PUBLIC) after 0123's; the production file was a248edf52f9191280ae5e03135d2da658c095b7d0eecb818d243b4e13e09fac9. BACKWARD COMPATIBLE: today's identity-api never calls the function and works unchanged with 0124 applied, so the release order is migration first, then the identity-api of this branch, whose staff context (STAFF_CONTEXT_SQL) adds one lateral call per membership and whose session adds facility.organizationKinds only when a kind is recorded (no change to the session of a membership with none). An identity-api image rollback is safe with 0124 left in place. ROLLBACK of the schema: a forward migration may drop the function only after no running identity-api calls it. PROVED 2026-11-17 on throwaway PostgreSQL 16 clusters run as pgrun (fictional data only, stopped and deleted afterwards): FRESH install of all 125 files: plan, dry run, apply, 0 pending, role bootstrap and verification; UPGRADE from 0001-0123 with production's runtime-grants.sql: plan exactly [0124] at the sha256 below, dry run rolled back (no function), applied (5 ms recorded), 0 pending, this branch's runtime-grants.sql applied and verified; the file again answers '0124: already applied', and on 0001-0122 '0124: 0001-0123 must be applied first'. Database suites (96: 16 in database/tests, 80 in test/database, including the new test/database/organization-staff-kinds.integration.sql): 96 pass on the fresh and on the upgraded database (schema owner the cluster superuser). The new suite checks the function's attributes, owner and ACL (Identity runtimes only, not PUBLIC, the schema test runtime or any other runtime; no runtime privilege on the two tables), eighteen fictional organisations (no application, each kind, a suspended product, an application with no product row, two and three products, other with each product, pending, reviewed and released self sign-ups, a self sign-up whose product is suspended), null and unknown ids, the same answers as hid_identity_runtime, and, with the sealed tenants installed as their suites do, QA Hospital {}, QA Laboratory {laboratory}, QA Pharmacy {pharmacy}, Demo Hospital {}, Demo Laboratory {laboratory}, Demo Pharmacy {pharmacy}, Demo Outreach {}, and admin@'s three memberships read by one lateral call each; three mutants of the body (other with laboratory as hospital, suspended products counted, released self sign-up counted) each fail it. identity-api's STAFF_CONTEXT_SQL, run as hid_identity_api_runtime on that database with the QA tenant installed, answers admin@'s memberships QA Hospital {}, QA Laboratory {laboratory}, QA Pharmacy {pharmacy}. identity-api: tsc --noEmit passes; full jest 105 suites, 2676 tests pass (product-gate.spec.ts pins admin@ on each site, lab-only, pharmacy-only and lab-and-pharmacy org_admin and admin, no-kind, hospital and clinic organisations, the other cases, review-pending administrators of a laboratory, a pharmacy, a hospital and a clinic, and unchanged clinical, lab and pharmacy roles). npm --prefix release test 98 of 98, release verify and scripts/verify-migration-ledger.mjs (125 migrations) pass. services/ehr-api scripts/test-staging-schema-upgrade.mjs on a throwaway local PostgreSQL 16 (NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS migrator): baseline 124 files with HEAD's runtime-grants.sql (production's), declared [0124_organization_staff_kinds.sql], dry run rolled back, applied, migration grants equal runtime-grants.sql (2626 privileges compared), clean install, row security unchanged (206), no-FORCE baseline: passed. The full TUF staging migration rehearsal (scripts/tuf-staging-migration-rehearsal.mjs, run as the non-root pgrun user on PostgreSQL 16.15) passed, schema upgrade 0028 to 0124, the 14 additional schema suites and the OTP, patient, emergency-contacts, provider-enrollment, order-routes and records-processing runtime verifiers included; the provider-enrollment verifier's staff-context check now also expects the kinds column (empty for its organisations with no application): 1000 memberships, the same rows as the query before P4b, p95 44.58 ms with both lateral calls.
